name: Guest_friendship
definition: Two individuals, Partner_1 and Partner_2 (jointly Partners), usually heads of households belonging to different communities, are bound by a lasting, reciprocal relationship of hospitality: each is obliged to receive, feed, protect, honour with gifts and send on the other (and often the other's descendants) whenever he comes to his community. The bond is typically founded or renewed by an exchange of Tokens (guest-gifts), may be inherited (Source_of_relationship), and is held to be under divine Sanction. Unlike Guest_and_host, the relation is symmetric and outlasts any single visit; unlike Personal_relationship, it is defined by mutual obligations of hospitality rather than by affection or kinship.

core_FEs.name: Partner_1
core_FEs.definition: One party to the guest-friendship, typically expressed as subject, possessor or dative of reference.

core_FEs.name: Partner_2
core_FEs.definition: The other party; with the relational noun ξένος 'guest-friend' it is the referent of the noun itself.

core_FEs.name: Partners
core_FEs.definition: Both parties expressed together, e.g. as a plural subject or with a reciprocal pronoun.

noncore_FEs.name: Token
noncore_FEs.definition: A gift exchanged to found, seal or later prove the bond (ξεινήιον, ξείνια).

noncore_FEs.name: Source_of_relationship
noncore_FEs.definition: What the bond derives from, e.g. inheritance from fathers (πατρώϊος) or an earlier act of hospitality.

noncore_FEs.name: Duration
noncore_FEs.definition: How long the bond has existed (e.g. παλαιός 'of long standing').

noncore_FEs.name: Descriptor
noncore_FEs.definition: A characterization of the bond (e.g. προσκηδής 'caring, affectionate').

noncore_FEs.name: Sanction
noncore_FEs.definition: The deity or norm that guarantees the bond (e.g. Ζεὺς ξείνιος, θέμις).

noncore_FEs.name: Place
noncore_FEs.definition: The community or house in which the obligations of the bond are exercised.

name: Tending
definition: A Caretaker gives sustained attention and work to a Ward (a person, a person's life or livelihood, a household, animals, plants or other property) so as to keep it in good condition or meet its needs, often on behalf of a Principal who owns or is responsible for the Ward. Unlike Assistance, no particular Goal of a Benefited_party is profiled; unlike Subordinates_and_superiors, no relation of command is required; unlike Growing_food, the Ward need not be a crop.

core_FEs.name: Caretaker
core_FEs.definition: The person who does the tending.

core_FEs.name: Ward
core_FEs.definition: The person, livelihood, animal, plant or property that is tended.

noncore_FEs.name: Principal
noncore_FEs.definition: The person on whose behalf or for whose benefit the Ward is tended, e.g. its owner.

noncore_FEs.name: Manner
noncore_FEs.definition: The way the tending is carried out (e.g. well, carefully).

noncore_FEs.name: Purpose
noncore_FEs.definition: What the Caretaker intends to achieve by the tending.
